• Distance: The total path length between two points is called distance.

questions.q:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

questions.solution:

• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.

• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.

• Sentence B will be the starting line as it contains the main idea of the parajumble i.e. Emotional sharing.

• However, Sentence D states that sharing laughter brings joy and freshness to relationships. So, D will follow B.

• Thus, the correct sequence is:

• B: Emotional sharing builds strong and lasting bonds.

• D: But sharing laughter brings joy and freshness to relationships.

• C: It also helps in healing resentments and hurt.

• A: Thus, shared laughter is one of the most effective tools in maintaining healthy relationships.
